claims.name: Cubic digamma--harmonic bridge
claims.convention: Constant term of the cutoff integral in the unit coordinate x; eta is the coefficient of u in strict Z2(1+u,1;1).
claims.qualification: An exact harmonic-coordinate reduction, not a finite ordinary-zeta evaluation.

claims.name: Normally convergent cubic Mittag--Leffler formula and primitive
claims.qualification: The entire remainder is eliminated by a two-point Cauchy contour argument; the primitive constant is zero at the singular origin.

claims.name: All admissible cubic Tornheim directions
claims.qualification: Two-coordinate formal reconstruction; no arithmetic independence or arithmetic minimality claim.

claims.name: Cubic transverse curves and sharp fourth-jet dependence
claims.qualification: Curves tangent to a polar divisor require a separate analysis.

claims.name: Mixed integer-order finite closure at arbitrary depth
claims.domain: Integer inner orders; positive integer weights; nonzero colors of modulus at most 1; free complex outer order by meromorphic continuation.
claims.depth_bound: At most q+1 when q positive inner orders and at least one nonpositive inner order occur.
claims.qualification: All outer-order derivatives allowed; differentiation of discrete inner orders is not asserted.

claims.name: All local Mellin principal parts in the integer-order sector
claims.qualification: Positive uncolored factors can create logarithmic poles and infinitely many nonpositive poles. All nontrivial colors give an entire outer-order continuation.

claims.name: Finite ordinary-constant expression for eta(1) and kappa
claims.qualification: Neither a finite evaluation in a specified ordinary constant algebra nor arithmetic independence is proved.

claims.name: Gaussian S6 and revised S8 candidates
claims.qualification: No exact target-vector certificate is supplied; existing conjecture labels remain unchanged.

novelty_scope: Specific continuations relative to the inspected repository corpus; no exhaustive worldwide-priority claim.
